confidence_notes: Sarandë-specific price observations support the restaurant, coffee and beer estimates, though sources differ on inexpensive meals. The cocktail estimate uses the midpoint of a published €4–8 range. I found no typical restaurant wine-by-the-glass price, so that anchor is estimated from local beer and wine-price context. Hostel private-room and basic-hotel prices are less certain; accommodation estimates are smoothed across published seasonal ranges with a small allowance for taxes and fees.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed; Sarandë-specific price observations and seasonal accommodation ranges were available.
